verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no explicit no-training policy or opt-out. The only indirect support is that Elasticsearch can be self-managed on-prem or in private cloud, and models can be deployed directly in Elasticsearch or replaced with your own pre-computed vectors. That lets a user keep data and inference inside their own infrastructure, but it is an inferred structural control, not a documented privacy guarantee. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that customer data is not used for model training, a data-usage or training opt-out policy for Elastic Cloud/Serverless, and clarity on data handling when external inference providers are used.
